lines.template: Quick breather. I'm using mine to find my pencil.

lines.speaker: barnaby

lines.speaker: barnaby

lines.template: You took that round the loud way, kid! Now do it again!

lines.template: One down! The rest of the cage just got a little roomier!

lines.template: Eliminated! That fighter's done; everybody else, keep swinging!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: KNOCKOUT! That's the end, that's the night, that's the headline!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: It's all over! That shot ended the argument and the evening!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: GOODNIGHT! A clean knockout, folks, and nobody's getting up from that!

lines.template: That ended suddenly. I had a whole paragraph prepared.

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: A finish. I'll underline it, which is my highest honour.

lines.template: I didn't even have time to sharpen my pencil for the second half.

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: All the way to the bell. Both of them have earned a sandwich.

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: They went the distance. I went the distance too, in this chair.

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Great fight. I'm putting it in my favourites, which is a sticky note.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: A career begins tonight, folks! First walk to the cage, first lights, first everything!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Remember this one! A brand-new career makes its debut tonight!

lines.template: This one's for the BELT, folks! Five rounds, one title, no refunds!

lines.template: Championship night! The belt is on the table and both fighters can smell it!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: It's a TITLE FIGHT! Somebody polish the gold, somebody hold my jacket!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The champ is defending! Everybody wants that belt, and only one fighter has it!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Career night in the cage! The record's on the line and the promoter is watching!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Another step up the card, folks! Win here and the phone starts ringing!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Our career fighter makes the walk! Purse on the line, pride on the line!

lines.template: Career fights have contracts. I have a contract too. It mentions snacks.

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: I hear the promoter is watching. I'm sitting up straighter.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Another one for the record book! The career keeps climbing!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: That's a career win, folks! The purse is earned and the phone is ringing!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Another win! I've lost count, which means it's a lot!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: NEW CHAMPION! Somebody bring the belt, and bring the big microphone!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The belt changes hands! A career just became a championship career!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: A tough night for the career, kid. Heal up. The gym's open tomorrow.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: That one goes in the loss column. Every champion has a few of those.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: So close to the gold, kid. The belt will still be there next time.

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: A career win. I'll add it to my scrapbook, which is also a napkin.

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Losses build character. I have a great deal of character.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Steam Vent! Stoke opens the pressure valve and the front row gets a facial!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: There's the Steam Vent! A scalding cone right in front of the newt!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Stoke the Fire! He's feeding the furnace, and the furnace is hungry!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: He just stoked his own fire. I can't even keep a candle lit.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Tide Spit! A glob of harbour water, lobbed with intent!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Dredge spat. I'm told that's legal and also a technique.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Anchor Drop! Dredge plants the claws and dares anybody to swing!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: He's dropped anchor! Hit him now and he'll hit you right back!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Gust Bomb! A ball of wind with a very bad attitude!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Gusto flaps one out! That Gust Bomb is looking for a face!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Hang Time! Gusto takes to the air and takes his time about it!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: He's hovering. I'd like to hover. My chair has other plans.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: BULLDOZE! Here comes Dozer, and he does not have brakes!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Dozer puts his head down and goes! Somebody move the furniture!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Dust Bowl! Dozer kicks up a cloud and everybody starts coughing!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: That dust cloud got into my notes. Now they're archaeology.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Sludge Lob! A gooey arc, and wherever it lands, the floor gets worse!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Slurry lobs the sludge! Watch your footing, folks, watch everybody's footing!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Drain Dive! Slurry slips under the floor and pops up somewhere rude!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: It went into the drain. I have so many questions about the plumbing.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Arc Lash! A little ball of lightning goes hunting!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Jitters lets an Arc Lash loose! That spark knows where you live!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Spring Pad down! Somebody's about to get launched, maybe on purpose!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: He put a trampoline in a cage fight. I support it completely.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Right in the steam! That vent cooked the whole front of the target!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Tide Spit lands! That's a faceful of cold harbour water!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Direct hit with spit. The crowd is torn between cheering and washing.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The Gust Bomb hits home! Blown back by a stiff breeze with opinions!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: That wind hit harder than my umbrella ever survived.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Bulldoze connects! Dozer just went through somebody like a front door!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Caught by the Bulldoze! That's a lot of Shovelsnout moving very fast!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Sludge Lob splashes down on target! That's going to be sticky for a while!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Arc Lash finds its mark! Zap, crackle, and a very surprised opponent!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Ghost Light catches up! That lantern never stops following!

lines.speaker: barnaby

lines.template: Tide Spit splashes the floor instead! At least the floor is wet now!

lines.template: Steam in the cage. My glasses fogged up, and I don't wear glasses.

lines.template: The Gust Bomb blew my notes into next week.

lines.template: There's sludge on the floor now. I'm told that's the plan.

lines.template: The spark followed them around. Sparks are very persistent.

lines.template: Varga cut the angle. I cut my sandwich into angles. Similar energy.

lines.template: MELTDOWN! Stoke's boiler blows its top and everything nearby gets toasted!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Born in a boiler room and raised on coal smoke: STOKE!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The newt with a furnace and a grudge! Turn up the heat for STOKE!

lines.template: He styles his crest before every fight and after every hit: GUSTO!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Quick wings, loud mouth, perfect hair: the Showboat Tern, GUSTO!

lines.template: Shovel first, questions never! Make some room for DOZER!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: He dug through three walls to get here tonight: it's DOZER!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Straight out of the storm drain, slick and smiling: SLURRY!

lines.template: One part jellyfish, three parts battery, all nerves: JITTERS!

lines.template: VARGA wins! The Cage Rules guest goes home with his house rules intact!

lines.template: Your winner, by technique and very sore shins: VARGA!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Your winner, from the bottom of the harbour: KNELL!

lines.template: Winner, winner, cannery dinner! What a performance!

lines.template: Up and over! That throw had a destination in mind!

lines.template: Bang, bang, BANG! The whole set lands!

lines.template: Four hits, no reply! Somebody call a timeout! We don't have timeouts!

lines.template: That combination had more steps than my morning routine.

lines.template: Next round! Fresh bell, same fighters, brand-new problems!

lines.template: FIGHT! The bell's rung, the crowd's up, and the cage door is shut!

lines.template: It's a championship fight, folks! Every round tonight is worth gold!

lines.template: Match point, folks! One more round win and somebody takes the fight!

lines.template: A TAUNT! Bold choice, folks, very bold, possibly unwise!

lines.template: Showboating in the middle of a fight! The crowd loves it, the opponent doesn't!

lines.template: Big wind-up! Everything's going into this one!

lines.template: Stamina's running dry! Every swing from here is on credit!

lines.template: Stoke fights like a boiler with the safety valve removed: all pressure, all the time.

lines.template: Watch the Furnace Haymaker. Stoke winds it up long, and it lands longer!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Jab, cross, hook: Stoke throws them in that order every time, and it still works!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: That chimney on Stoke's head puffs harder the angrier he gets. It's puffing now!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Stoke's furnace is glowing. I keep wanting to roast something on it.

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Stoke's tail is short. His temper is shorter. I've measured both.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Dredge is slow on the feet but fast with the claws. Don't stand in front of him!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: That big crusher claw does the talking. The little claw does the paperwork!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Hitting Dredge on the shell is like knocking on a bank vault!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Dredge loves a long fight. The longer it goes, the more the tide comes in!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Dredge's eyes are on stalks. He can watch the fight and the snack stand at once.

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: The barnacles on Dredge are glowing. I hope that's normal for barnacles.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Gusto's quick on the wing and quicker with the mouth. The kicks are fast too!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Gusto hates getting pinned down. Keep him moving and he's dangerous!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Those long legs are pure reach. Gusto kicks from a different postcode!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Light frame, big heart, bigger ego: that's Gusto in a nutshell!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Gusto checked his watch in the middle of the round. He doesn't have a watch.

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Gusto's crest hasn't moved all fight. I think it's lacquered.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Dozer doesn't do angles. Dozer does straight lines through whatever's there!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Get Dozer turning and he's slow. Let him charge and he's a freight train!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: That shovel snout isn't decoration. Dozer digs opponents out of position!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The heaviest hitter on the card, folks, and he knows exactly one direction!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Dozer's headlamp is on. I don't know who it's for, but I appreciate it.

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Dozer snuffled the floor. I believe he's looking for truffles.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Slurry's whole body is a weapon: head, tail, fangs, and the floor it leaves behind!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: That head butt reaches farther than it looks. Slurry lives on it!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Slurry wants you standing in the sludge. Every puddle is a plan!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Slurry stays low and sneaky. Good luck finding a clean target on that wyrm!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Slurry sways when it's thinking. Slurry is always thinking.

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: I tried to describe Slurry's shape. I wrote "long" and stopped there.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Jitters is small, jumpy and loaded with volts. Every touch comes with a buzz!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Don't let Jitters get underneath you. That little jelly hits harder than he looks!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The coil inside Jitters is glowing brighter. That's a jelly with a charge!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Slap, double slap, headbonk! Jitters' whole offence sounds like a cartoon!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Jitters hasn't stopped bouncing since the bell. I'm tired just watching.

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Jitters has antennae. They're for balance, or for receiving radio. Maybe both.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Sizzle! That's a burn that ticks away and slows the stamina too!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Somebody's Sizzling! Five seconds of burn and a very short temper!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Sizzle. I can smell it from here. It smells like breakfast.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Soaked! Slower feet, shorter dodges, and they'll fly farther when hit!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: That fighter's Soaked through! And water plus volts is a bad combination!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Soaked. I'd offer a towel, but I'm using mine as a napkin.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Jolted! Little shocks every second, and those cooldowns crawl!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: They're Jolted! Every pulse locks them up for a heartbeat!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Jolted. I touched the booth railing once. I understand completely.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Gunked! Sludge that burns, a guard that costs more, healing that barely works!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: That's Gunked! The guard just got expensive and the medicine stopped working!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Gunked. That fighter now looks like my kitchen sink.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Caked in grit! Less poise, slower recovery, and dodging costs a fortune!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Caked! That mud makes every heavy hit stagger them harder!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Caked. I don't recommend it as a skincare routine.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Winded! No stamina coming back, and every dodge costs double!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: They're Winded! Easy to shove, easy to knock around, hard to escape!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Winded. I get winded on the stairs up to this booth.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: ELEMENTAL REACTION! Two elements meet and nobody's happy about it!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Whoa, a reaction! The elements just picked a fight of their own!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: STEAM BURST! Fire meets water and the whole cage turns into a kettle!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: BACKDRAFT! The wind feeds the flames and the flames say thank you!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: MUDBOUND! Brine and grit make mud, and mud makes everybody slow!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: DILUTE! The water washes the sludge out in one big splash!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: CATALYZE! The volts cook the sludge faster! That stings twice!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: CRUST! Sludge and grit set hard, and nobody's dodging out of that shell!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: SPRAY! The wind flings the sludge everywhere! Everywhere, folks!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: SANDBLAST! A face full of grit, and the guard is wide open!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: BELL RINGER! Scrap meets spectral and the whole head rings!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: GRAVE CHILL! Spectral cold in harbour water, right down to the bones!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: CRACK GUARD! Scrap into grit, and that guard just split down the middle!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The arena joins the fight! Watch your feet, folks, the floor has opinions!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Hazard's live! Somebody's about to get a very rude surprise!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: The arena moved again. I've stopped trusting the furniture.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Here comes the gust! Hold on to something that isn't the edge!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The plate is live! Stay on the rubber mats, kids, the steel is cooking!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The tide's in the gutter! Everybody's ankles, consider yourselves warned!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Somebody scooped up the pickup! Free stuff always tastes better!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Health pickup grabbed! That's a second wind, straight off the floor!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Boing! Off the Spring Pad and straight up!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Someone just used the trampoline. Respect.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Tag! Fresh legs come into the cage!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The tag is made! In comes the partner, swinging!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: They tagged out. I'd like to tag out of this booth for a sandwich.

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: I think the cage just moved. Barnaby says it was only the camera.

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: I thought Brine was a drink. Barnaby says it is not a drink.

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: If the floor starts talking, Barnaby, I am letting you answer it.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Haunted lasts five seconds: cooldowns recover slower and healing is twenty percent weaker.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Haunted slows cooldown recovery by a quarter and cuts received healing by a fifth.

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Haunted slows your cooldowns down. Mine are slow already.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Port Hook! Knell's quick light hook keeps the opponent turning.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: IT'S OVER! Goodnight, good luck, and good grief!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: KNOCKED OUT! Call Doc Sutura! Call her gently!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: KO by HEAVY! That's a headline, folks, I'll write it myself!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: KO by THROW! He went from fighter to luggage!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: KO by the JUICE! Glandco would like you to know it's "probably fine"!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: He got burned out, folks! The floor did the paperwork!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: AND THERE GOES A PIECE OF HIM! Somebody grab that, it's a souvenir!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Under thirty seconds! Refunds are not available, that's in the waiver!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: OFF THE ROOF! He's fine! Probably! It's a tall building!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: DOWN! Down goes the critter!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Timber, folks! That's a full ragdoll!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Legs said no! The rest of him agreed!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: THROWN! He's gonna land in a different weight class!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Tripped! It's the little ones that get you!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Three knockdowns! The canvas is filing for a restraining order!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: MELTDOWN! The door's open and the newt's not home!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: HIGH TIDE! Everybody's ankles just got heavy!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: HURRICANE STRUT! He's faster and, somehow, louder!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: LANDSLIDE! Please move your vehicles!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: OVERFLOW! Evacuate the floor! The floor is leaving anyway!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: OVERCHARGE! The jelly is BIGGER and that's a problem for everyone!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: OH! That one came with a return address!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: HE FELT THAT in the parking lot!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Fully charged! Somebody check the cage for dents!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Physics just filed a complaint!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: INTO THE SPONSOR BOARD! The sponsor is thrilled!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: UP goes the critter! Gravity's turn now!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Caught him WINDING UP! That's a counter, folks, that's reading the mail!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Fifteen-plus! The commissioner is pretending not to look!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: One, two, THREE! That's arithmetic, folks!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: FINISHER! And the follow-through had a follow-through!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Four in a row! Somebody's been doing their bag work!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: PARRIED! Timed to the hair!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: A HEAVY, parried! That's a crime in six districts!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Touch gloves, claws, beaks, whatever you've got, and FIGHT!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Bell! Go! That's the whole rulebook!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: SUDDEN DEATH! One hit, folks! Everyone is made of glass! Be the hammer!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: ONE TOUCH and it's over! That's the most honest thing this league does!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: OVER THE EDGE! The next roof will be in touch!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: THE WIND did that! The weather is undefeated!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: BOTH of them! Off opposite sides! That's symmetry! I love symmetry!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: STOKE takes it! Somebody open a window, the newt's still cooking!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: DREDGE wins! He will now return to the dock and feel nothing!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: GUSTO wins and he knew it an hour ago!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: DOZER wins! Now somebody turn him around!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: SLURRY wins! Please do not shake its hand, it doesn't have one!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: JITTERS wins and he's just as surprised as you are!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: That swing missed by a whole dock's width.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: One shoulder turn took the sting off that shot and changed the angle.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The first strike was a test. The second one was the actual assignment.
